from scipy.optimize import least_squares
one=np.ones_like(P); L=np.log(P); S=np.sqrt(P)
def model(b):
    F=np.column_stack([one,P,P**2,1/P,L,P*L,S,t*S,np.exp(-b*P),t*np.exp(-b*P)])
    c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(F,dP_dt,rcond=None)
    return F,c

    F,c=model(b); r=dP_dt-F@c
    print(b, np.mean(r**2)/np.var(dP_dt))

from scipy.optimize import minimize_scalar

def model(b):
    F=np.column_stack([one,P,P**2,1/P,L,P*L,S,t*S,np.exp(-b*P),t*np.exp(-b*P)])
    c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(F,dP_dt,rcond=None)
